verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Gusto Embedded Payroll's API surface (payroll processing, webhooks, contractor payments, time off, MCP dev tools) and general platform features like 'tax configuration and compliance,' but nothing describes proactive alerts triggered by new hires, new locations, or law changes creating compliance obligations. Webhooks documented (e.g., payroll.paid) are transactional, not compliance-alerting.
